'''Gornash''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent and a false [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophet of the Dark Side]].

==Biography==
He coordinated the activities of the group's spies from their headquarters on [[Scardia Station]].

All the false Prophets of the Dark Side, but one named [[Orloc]], were killed when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati|Makati]] [[Bombardment of Scardia Station|bombarded]] [[Scardia Station]].<ref name="ENDTSD" />
